paper: Friedman & Dieng 2023, 'The Vendi Score: A Diversity Evaluation Metric for Machine Learning', TMLR 2023, arXiv:2210.02410
reference_function: vendi_score/vendi.py :: score_K(K, q=1, p=None, normalize=False) [lines 30-38] -> weight_K(K,None)=K/n [lines 8-12]; w=scipy.linalg.eigvalsh(K/n); entropy_q(w,q=1)=-(w[w>0]*log(w[w>0])).sum() [lines 22-27]; return exp(entropy)
blme_function: _vendi_score(X, kernel='cosine'|'rbf', gamma=None) -> builds nonlinear PSD kernel with unit diagonal, then runs the score_K algebra verbatim (same scipy.linalg.eigvalsh, same positive-eigval mask)
definition: Given n samples and a PSD similarity matrix K (K_ii=1), let K/n have eigenvalues lambda_1..lambda_n (>=0, sum=1). VS_{q=1} = exp(-sum_i lambda_i log lambda_i). The effective number of distinct samples.
distinctness_note: Uses a NONLINEAR kernel (cosine default, rbf optional) on the representations, deliberately distinct from effective_rank / RankMe which use the raw (linear) singular-value spectrum.

cosine_mid.description: 4 clusters x 2 near-duplicate rows (1e-3 jitter), cosine; rng chain consumes the (8,5) random cloud first

anchors.identical_rows_VS_eq_1: n identical rows -> K all-ones -> VS = 1 (PASS)
anchors.orthonormal_rows_VS_eq_n: n mutually orthogonal unit rows -> K = I -> VS = n (PASS, n=7)
anchors.bounded_1_to_n: VS in [1, n] for random cosine clouds (PASS, n=4,10,25)
